_note: Draft English rendering of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Devarim 10, generated by scripts/translate_tafsir_english.py against the JA (not the biblical Hebrew). Translation goal: reverse-translatability for the Tafsir reader — readers should be able to map English back to JA. Saadia-specific moves preserved per data-source/saadia-gloss-table.json; Blau's notes (data-source/blau-genesis-notes.json) consulted for Bereshit 1-12.

translations.1: At that time God said to me: 'Hew two tablets of gems like the first ones, and ascend with them to the mountain — after you have made a chest of wood.'
translations.2: 'So that I may write upon them the words that were upon the first two tablets, which you broke; and place them in the chest.'
translations.3: And I made a chest of acacia wood, and I hewed two tablets of gems like the first ones, and I ascended to the mountain, with the two of them in my hands.
translations.4: And He wrote upon them according to the first writing — they are the Ten Words which God had spoken to you on the mountain from within the fire on the day of the assembly — and He delivered them to me.
translations.5: Then I turned and descended from the mountain, and I placed the two tablets in the chest that I had made; and they remained there, as God had commanded me.
translations.6: And when He accepted my intercession concerning Aaron, he endured until the sons of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Bene-Yaakan to Moserah; there Aaron died and was buried there, and Eleazar his son served in his place.
translations.7: And they journeyed from there to Gudgod, and from Gudgod to Yotbath — a land with valleys of water.
translations.8: At that time God set apart the tribe of Levi, to carry the ark of His covenant and to stand before Him to serve Him and to bless in His name — unto this day of ours — because they came to my aid.
translations.9: And therefore the Levites had no portion and inheritance together with their brothers; rather the gifts of God are their portion, as He decreed for them.
translations.10: And I stayed on the mountain like the first time — forty days and forty nights — and God hearkened to me at that time, and God did not will to destroy you.
translations.11: And God said to me: 'Arise, go before the people and set them journeying, that they may go and inherit the land which I have sworn to their fathers that I would give them.'
translations.12: And now, O Israel — what is it that God your Lord requires of you, but that you fear Him, and walk in His ways, and love Him, and serve Him wholeheartedly, with all your heart and your soul,
translations.13: and keep His commandments and His statutes which I command you today — that it may go well for you?
translations.14: Behold, to God your Lord belong all the heavens, and the earth, and all that is in it.
translations.15: Yet He chose your fathers and loved them, and chose their offspring after them — and affiliated them to Himself from among the peoples, as you can see.
translations.16: So remove the covering of your hearts, and your necks — do not stiffen them ever.
translations.17: For God your Lord is the Lord of lords and Master of masters — the mighty, the great, the powerful, the awe-inspiring — who shows no partiality and takes no bribe,
translations.18: who renders judgment for the orphan and the widow, and who loves the stranger, providing him food and clothing.
translations.19: So love the stranger, for long you were strangers in the land of Egypt.
translations.20: Fear God your Lord, serve Him, cleave to His obedience, and swear by His name uprightly.
translations.21: He is your praise and He is your God — who did with you those great and awesome things which your own eyes have seen.
translations.22: Among them: your fathers went down to Egypt with seventy souls — and now God your Lord has made you as numerous as the stars of the sky.
